current_source_negative_cases.primary_source_review: Focus50 permits certification of completed destruction in lieu of return. Its supplied units47/48/50 do not expressly grant post-disposal retention. Do not infer a retention allowance from a destruction substitute.

evidence.quote: In such an instance, such Participating Entity shall identify in writing the specific Confidential Information retained, and shall provide the affected Participating Entity or Participating Entities with a written commitment to return or destroy the retained Confidential Information upon the expiration of the retention period required by law.

current_source_negative_cases.primary_source_review: Focus52 adds identification and a written commitment for later return/destruction; it is not itself an express grant of retention. Its actual window47/48/52 omits the governing retention permission51; context and focus must remain distinct.

source_units.text: 6. Return or Destruction of Confidential Information.

Upon termination of this Agreement, all Confidential Information in the possession or control of a Participating Entity and its Representatives that received such information shall be returned to the Participating Entity that disclosed the information, including all copies of such information in any form whatsoever, unless otherwise instructed in writing by the Participating Entity that disclosed the information.

In such an instance, such Participating Entity shall identify in writing the specific Confidential Information retained, and shall provide the affected Participating Entity or Participating Entities with a written commitment to return or destroy the retained Confidential Information upon the expiration of the retention period required by law.

evidence.quote: The obligation under this Agreement to maintain the confidentiality of all Confidential Information shall continue to apply to such retained Confidential Information for so long as the Participating Entity possesses such Confidential Information.

current_source_negative_cases.primary_source_review: Focus53 keeps confidentiality duties in force for retained information. Continuing an obligation does not grant a right to retain.
